verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a game-engine and services platform, but the evidence pack documents no first-party capability to export all project or service data in open formats. The closest items are the Asset Database keeping original source files alongside imported versions and the per-service Web API OpenAPI specs. Those are adjacent developer building blocks, not a documented bulk-export or exit path, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
